literal: Embrace - between - cool - wind - to pass through - pallor - attained - naive woman's - large - rain - eyes.
translation: When a cool breeze passed between our embrace, the large, rain-cool eyes of this naive girl turned pale.
modern: எங்கள் தழுவலுக்கு இடையே ஒரு குளிர்ந்த காற்று புகுந்து சென்றதற்கே, இந்தப் பேதைப் பெண்ணின் பெரிய குளிர்ந்த கண்கள் பசலை நிறம் அடைந்துவிட்டன.
explanation: The hero marvels at the extreme delicacy of his lover's affection. Even during a tight embrace, a momentary gap that allowed a cool breeze to pass between them was enough to make her feel the pain of separation. Instantly, her large, rain-cool eyes turned pale with sorrow. The word 'பேதை' (naive girl) highlights her innocent and overly sensitive nature in love, unable to bear even the slightest physical distance.
